Update from DC re WHCD shooting

Video
I've just heard about the shooting at the White House Correspondents Dinner. I was at that location earlier but am not there and am fine. The situation seems absolutely insane.

Let’s hold up a second. Yes, Trump fell asleep again in the Oval Office. Yes, he’s unfit for the job. Yes, he’s quickly losing his cognitive abilities. Yes, he should be removed immediately. But this image that is spreading virally of Trump bonking his head on the Resolute Desk is AI.
Remember Trump’s first term, the quaint one, where he lovingly suggested people inject themselves with bleach to clean themselves out of COVID germs? Simpler times.
New substack just dropped ⬇️ substack.davidpakman.com/p/w…

NURSE, GET THE BEDPAN! Seriously, what is happening at the White House?

Video
Trump fell COMPLETELY ASLEEP at the White House yesterday during a public event. He might have been close to REM. The “health truthers” are notably silent.

He's just resting his eyes

Video

Truly unmatched energy


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Trump is about to hit REM on camera during an Oval Office event. It's just incredible.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2047400412366397611#m

You can already see the shift in tone and messaging. Republicans are quietly preparing for a brutal midterm loss while publicly pretending everything is fine, but setting up off-ramps and excuses. They know what’s coming.

Trump will be showing up to the White House Correspondents dinner tomorrow for the first time as President, attacking media outlets who criticize him, and leaving before anyone makes any jokes about him. Truly the behavior of a Real Man™

They keep declaring wins no one can find

Video

Someone had to say it


Acyn (@Acyn)

Reporter: What do you make of Republicans saying that Virginia—

AOC: Wah wah wah. 

Republicans have fought for partisan gerrymanders across the United States of America. And these are the rules that they have set.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Acyn/status/2047057822186373229#m

LOL


David Pakman Show (@davidpakmanshow)

This didn't age well

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/davidpakmanshow/status/2047066195958911486#m

The Liquor Cabinet, brought to you by Pete Hegseth


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

MAGA, all summer long 😎

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/WhiteHouse/status/2046987551802548688#m

Ironic choice of words for sure


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

Hottest country in the world!!!





— https://nitter.net/WhiteHouse/status/2046975903096316382#m
We are halfway through week 8 of Trump’s 3-4 week war. Really makes you think.

Gas prices are up, inflation is up, job creation is down, but  Trump's Fed Chair nominee grades this economy an A for the working class. Does that sound right to anybody?


Headquarters (@HQNewsNow)

Trump's Fed Chair nominee grades Trump's economy an A despite plummeting GDP, rising inflation, and skyrocketing gas prices

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/HQNewsNow/status/2046626333321486691#m

Trump and Republicans are suddenly realizing that if they lose the House in November, Trump’s presidency is effectively over, and they know that this is likely to happen. Trump is panicking. We need to make this outcome a reality.

Former Republican says IT'S OVER
This is a new low, even for MAGA people
LEAK: Trump is ABSOLUTELY TERRIFIED
